verdict.rationale: Nothing in the pack documents pairing a card reader with the POS app or registering one to an account. Tap to Pay turns the phone itself into a checkout, which is a different, reader-free payment path, and POS Hub mentions connecting unspecified 'peripherals' over USB without naming card readers. Neither covers reader pairing, and nothing supports the 'within minutes' setup time.

support.subject: As a merchant-ops user, I can pair a card reader with the POS app or register it to my account and take a payment within minutes
